entities.summary: The University of Gloucestershire is a public university based in Gloucestershire, England. It is located over four campuses; two in Cheltenham and two in Gloucester. University of Gloucestershire is a educational organization in Europe, established in 2001. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
